role: single-entry machine-readable CACE repository handoff; navigation and policy, not verification evidence

project.name: CACE Studio
project.target: rigorous browser-accessible scientific/mathematical Studio with shared desktop/web/CLI/agent semantics

bug_flush_loop: add permanent structural guard when possible
for unknown implementation features: rank candidate approaches before inventing a new architecture
preserve all affected architectural invariants through the fix/implementation
if a new helper tool is required, add typed contract + regression tests + permanent bug-sweep guard where practical
security_invariants: proof runner isolated from untrusted web requests
zero-contact AI has no network/cloud credentials/direct shell
plugins denied capabilities by default in production target
critical run evidence retained outside GitHub
web gateway is the only client-visible application service
browser cannot directly reach local AI/model server, databases, wallet RPC, scientific/native workers, pairing/economy brokers, filesystem workers, or Lean runner
protected local services bind only loopback/private namespace/Unix-domain sockets and are not public listeners

independent_log_retention.github_role: additional convenience copy, never sole archive

webapp_layers: private account/protein/network/economy/payment brokers and durable storage

semantics_rule.semantic_change_rule: Any transform that changes computation must be an explicit typed graph operation and invalidate/recompute dependent evidence.

hard_rules: Never weaken proof scope or negative tests merely to pass CI.
Never turn NOT_RUN/absent verification into PASS.
Never treat numerical evidence as continuum proof.
Never treat AI output as verification evidence.
Never treat provenance/signatures/log retention as mathematical proof.
Never claim production readiness from formal proof alone.
Preserve theorem hypotheses and unresolved obligations.

network_security.collaboration: separate authenticated capability broker with fixed typed canvas-operation schema
network_security.licensing: separate broker returns only signed quote/license capability data

commercial_model.xmr_pricing_rule: quote at purchase from USD policy; do not use long-lived hard-coded XMR economic price
commercial_model.evidence_rule: payment/license state never creates or strengthens scientific evidence
commercial_model.canonical_monero_wallet_rule: Reuse the existing CACE wallet; do not generate a replacement wallet. Invoice subaddresses, if used, must belong to the same wallet custody.

current_theorem_roadmap.immediate_gap: v3.40 proves closure inheritance for any certified zero-boundary core but does not construct a useful concrete box boundary-vanishing core
current_theorem_roadmap.execution_rule: quarantine-first; standalone Exact-Pin before audited promotion; canonical qualification only after audited-root Exact-Pin

account_and_enterprise_proof_commerce.password_storage: Argon2id salted/verioned; never plaintext; runner has no credential access
account_and_enterprise_proof_commerce.enterprise_proof_delivery: contract + payment + qualified proof -> reviewed LaTeX/PDF through separate document/mail services
account_and_enterprise_proof_commerce.ip_rule: retain CACE Background IP; assign/license agreed customer-specific Foreground deliverables only to the extent legally transferable

sequence: render customer PDF from already-qualified artifact
enterprise_proof_ordering.hard_rule: Do not sell a bespoke proof as a completed rigorous result before proof-ready qualification succeeds.

required_measures: public/customer interface separated from private theorem implementations
encryption at rest and authenticated encrypted transport
periodic access reviews and prompt offboarding

compute_entitlements.cuda: available toggle only when compatible NVIDIA CUDA backend is detected
compute_entitlements.provenance_rule: record requested/actual backend, device/CUDA identity, thread count, and fallback; no effect on proof status

source_secrecy.principle: do not ship crown jewels; minimize sensitive local execution; harden what must ship; verify the final artifact
source_secrecy.encryption: authenticated encryption at rest (AES-GCM with hardware acceleration or XChaCha20-Poly1305 as appropriate); keys never hard-coded
source_secrecy.gpu_rule: numeric buffers and opaque operation IDs only; no theorem/proof/source/secrets in GPU memory
source_secrecy.hard_limit: customer-controlled CPU/GPU execution cannot be made impossible to reverse engineer

proof_job_minimization.rule: Group user-triggered Lean work when rigor is unchanged.
development_flow: write compatible theorem modules in quarantine
run one manual batched exact-pin compile for all ready quarantined modules
fix every failure and rerun the batch only when needed
run final exact-head canonical qualification on the promoted head
proof_job_minimization.nonclaim: Batched preflight is engineering/formal-preflight only and never qualification.

cross_chat_continuity.standing_directive: Every substantive CACE chat retrieves the durable handoff and idea ledger, re-verifies live state, preserves new meritorious ideas, and refreshes/mirrors continuity before a natural stopping point.
cross_chat_continuity.live_state_rule: Handoff status is a snapshot only. Re-query GitHub branch/PR/commit/Actions state before proof, deployment, or qualification actions.
cross_chat_continuity.evidence_rule: Continuity records and chat memory never create proof or verification evidence.

library_mirror_status.retry_rule: Future CACE chat with working Library write access should upload the current handoff and idea ledger, verify them by Library search/read, then update this status.

build_lite.role: low-cost deterministic build/test planning for human and AI code builders; never verification evidence
build_lite.proof_rule: proof-sensitive exact cache hits are restore-only and never skip qualification-sensitive work
build_lite.execution_rule: planner emits JSON/commands but does not execute or modify source by itself

code_builder_bootstrap.target: complete production CACE application, not a mock/demo replacement
code_builder_bootstrap.supported_agent_shape: GitHub-connected code builders including Base44, Gemini AI Studio, Codex, and equivalent tools
code_builder_bootstrap.semantic_rule: generated UI/backend layers consume canonical CACE typed APIs; they do not invent a second scientific/proof semantics
code_builder_bootstrap.unknown_feature_rule: Attempt every required feature. When implementation is unclear, generate/rank 10 approaches, use CACE Build Lite/CACE tools to select a viable architecture-preserving approach, or build a narrow tested helper tool. Never silently omit or fake the feature.
code_builder_bootstrap.architecture_rule: Preserve all established CACE architectures/invariants unless an explicit reviewed migration supersedes them.

product_experience.target: full-featured production-grade mathematics and sciences playground that just works
product_experience.self_sandboxing: private/local service plane starts hardened by default; browser sees only gateway
product_experience.graceful_degradation: optional unavailable backends stay unavailable/not-run instead of weakening correctness
product_experience.trial: no credit card; one verified person/trial; non-destructive limited mode after expiry

public_help.proprietary_boundary: never disclose custom math/derivations/algorithms/theorem bodies/source internals/hidden defaults

multi_tenant.recommendation: shared stateless web/control plane with isolated tenant/job sandboxes and durable tenant state
multi_tenant.instance_rule: one logical CACE instance per account; shared immutable release code; never per-user source drift
multi_tenant.availability: logical instance remains available while compute may warm, suspend, resume or move
multi_tenant.local_agent_rule: user-network agents connect outbound through authenticated pairing/broker transport
multi_tenant.fairness: tenant quotas, separate interactive/batch queues, backpressure and starvation-resistant scheduling
